book_cn: 外研社版选择性必修第四册
unit_cn: Unit 5 The Mysteries of the Maya 玛雅之谜
source: 外研社版(新标准)选择性必修第四册 Unit 5 词表(p50-60 真词);IPA 英音标准词典回填;例句原创、玛雅文明/考古/探索未知主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: The Maya built one of the greatest civilisations in the Americas.
words.example_cn: 玛雅人建立了美洲最伟大的文明之一。

words.example_en: Why the Maya left their cities is still a mystery.
words.example_cn: 玛雅人为何离开他们的城市仍是个谜。

words.meaning_cn: 激起……的兴趣;引起……的好奇心
words.example_en: The lost city continued to intrigue young researchers everywhere.
words.example_cn: 这座失落的城市持续激起各地年轻研究者的兴趣。

words.example_en: Thick jungle came to bury the old temples for hundreds of years.
words.example_cn: 茂密的丛林把古老的神庙掩埋了数百年。

words.example_en: The Maya built a huge stone pyramid in the centre of the city.
words.example_cn: 玛雅人在城市中心建造了一座巨大的石头金字塔。

words.example_en: Their knowledge of astronomy helped them make an accurate calendar.
words.example_cn: 他们的天文学知识帮助他们制定了精确的历法。

words.example_en: The Maya dug a long canal to carry water to their fields.
words.example_cn: 玛雅人挖了一条长长的水渠把水引到田里。

words.example_en: The cities were hidden deep inside a hot tropical forest.
words.example_cn: 这些城市藏在炎热的热带森林深处。

words.example_en: Fewer than usual a cyclone reached the coast during those years.
words.example_cn: 那些年到达海岸的气旋比往常更少。

words.example_en: Droughts may have caused the downfall of the great cities.
words.example_cn: 干旱也许导致了这些大城市的衰败。

words.example_en: Today only a stone ruin marks where the city once stood.
words.example_cn: 如今只有一片石头废墟标示着这座城市曾经的位置。

words.example_en: Something forced the people to abandon their homes forever.
words.example_cn: 某种原因迫使人们永远离弃了自己的家园。

words.example_en: Scholars were quick to dismiss the boy's idea as a guess.
words.example_cn: 学者们很快否定了这个男孩的想法,认为只是猜测。

words.example_en: The expansion of the population called for more farmland.
words.example_cn: 人口的增长需要更多的农田。

words.example_en: When danger appears, a quick getaway can be a sensible choice.
words.example_cn: 危险出现时,迅速逃走可能是明智的选择。

words.example_en: Some of our ancestors chose to retreat from the unknown.
words.example_cn: 我们的一些祖先选择从未知中退避。

words.example_en: Brave explorers learn to subdue their fear and move ahead.
words.example_cn: 勇敢的探险者学会克制恐惧、继续前进。

words.meaning_cn: 地图上没有标明的;未知的
words.example_en: Amundsen set out into uncharted land to reach the South Pole.
words.example_cn: 阿蒙森动身进入地图上没有标明的土地,去往南极。

words.example_en: These discoveries help us delve into the secrets of the deep sea.
words.example_cn: 这些发现帮助我们探究深海的奥秘。

words.example_en: There is no need to shrink from a new and strange situation.
words.example_cn: 没有必要在新奇而陌生的情境前退缩。

words.example_en: A careful investigation may finally solve this ancient puzzle.
words.example_cn: 一项细致的调查也许最终能解开这个古老的谜题。

words.example_en: Divers found an old shipwreck lying on the sea bed.
words.example_cn: 潜水员发现一艘古老的沉船躺在海床上。

words.example_en: Many archaeological finds are made in shallow waters near the coast.
words.example_cn: 许多考古发现是在靠近海岸的浅水中取得的。

words.example_en: Some deep-sea coral may be four thousand years old.
words.example_cn: 有些深海珊瑚可能有四千年之久。

words.example_en: This coral grows only one or two millimetres each year.
words.example_cn: 这种珊瑚每年只生长一到两毫米。

words.example_en: The strange fish can look upwards through its clear forehead.
words.example_cn: 这种奇怪的鱼能透过透明的额头向上看。

words.example_en: In the deepest trench the pressure is almost unimaginable.
words.example_cn: 在最深的海沟里,压力几乎难以想象。

words.example_en: The pressure there is equivalent to fifty aeroplanes stacked up.
words.example_cn: 那里的压力相当于五十架飞机叠在一起。

words.phrase_en: stack one on top of another
words.example_en: Imagine fifty planes stacked one on top of another.
words.example_cn: 想象五十架飞机一架摞在另一架上面。

words.example_en: Furthermore, the oceans are a valuable source of natural resources.
words.example_cn: 此外,海洋是宝贵的自然资源来源。

words.meaning_cn: 显著的;值得注意的;显要的
words.example_en: The most notable find was a strange ice-like substance.
words.example_cn: 最值得注意的发现是一种奇怪的冰状物质。

words.example_en: China found an ice-like substance under the South China Sea.
words.example_cn: 中国在南海下面发现了一种冰状物质。

words.example_en: China's underwater vessel reached a depth of seven thousand metres.
words.example_cn: 中国的潜水器到达了七千米的深度。

words.example_en: The research helps identify good areas for deep-sea drilling.
words.example_cn: 这项研究有助于确定适合深海钻探的区域。

words.example_en: She quoted a famous line from volume five of the old book.
words.example_cn: 她引用了那本旧书第五卷里一句著名的话。

words.example_en: Once-great cities can fall into ruin within a few generations.
words.example_cn: 曾经辉煌的城市可能在几代人之内便衰落败落。

words.meaning_cn: 动身;踏上(漫长的)旅途;着手
words.example_en: The explorers set out to find the city hidden in the jungle.
words.example_cn: 探险者们出发去寻找藏在丛林中的城市。

words.meaning_cn: 不为人知的地方;未知事物
words.example_en: These reactions help humankind delve into the unknown.
words.example_cn: 这些反应帮助人类探索未知。

words.example_en: You may be tempted to check out a strange object you find.
words.example_cn: 你可能很想去查看一下发现的奇怪物体。

words.example_en: We should always look into things first before we act.
words.example_cn: 行动之前我们总该先把事情调查清楚。

words.example_en: It is never wrong to think twice before taking action.
words.example_cn: 行动之前慎重考虑从来都没有错。

words.example_en: Sometimes it is safer to steer clear of the unfamiliar.
words.example_cn: 有时避开陌生的事物会更安全。

words.example_en: Exploration does not mean blindly to throw oneself into danger.
words.example_cn: 探索并不意味着盲目地投身于危险之中。

words.example_en: He wanted to test the waters of a brand-new situation.
words.example_cn: 他想试探一下全新情境的水深。

words.example_en: Our ancestors would run for their lives from wild animals.
words.example_cn: 我们的祖先会为了逃命而躲开野兽。

words.example_en: Making a quick getaway can be a natural and sensible response.
words.example_cn: 迅速逃走可能是一种自然而明智的反应。
